links.comparator_used: Schema validation alone (accepted all 97 candidates) and an earlier packet-level evidence check (accepted 94)
links.outcome: Number of extracted numeric laboratory candidates admitted to the record after verification against the source document
links.effect: 97 numeric candidates from 9 reports (102 manually labelled rows): schema validation accepted 97, earlier packet-level check accepted 94, hardened quotation- and row-level policy admitted 72 and retained 25 for review
links.tradeoff: 25 candidates are held back for human review rather than admitted. The study evaluates system integrity, not clinical correctness or safety, so it does not say how many of the refused candidates were actually wrong.
links.quote: The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review.

design_hint: deterministic source-grounded verification gate with human review of refused outputs
